note: Recast from the original description of Emerson 1925 (in English), where the species was placed in the subgenus Kalotermes (Rugitermes); the description is based on a single queen (holotype) and several soldiers from the same nest, the type locality being Kartabo, British Guiana. The row labels of the alate measurement table are damaged in the scan and no values are given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The pronotum is yellow and contrasts strongly with the black head and dark wing scales, which is what the specific name refers to; the soldier head width is 1.80—2.07 mm, distinctly greater than in K. magninotus (1.38—1.48 mm) and K. flavicinctus (1.19—1.35 mm) of the same genus; the upper part of the tibia is concolorous with the femur and only the lower part, near the tarsus, is distinctly paler, which separates this species from those two.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Queen: head black or extremely dark brown; antenna yellow (broken after segment 9), segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Eyes small, 0.26 mm from the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, 0.08 mm from the eye. Labrum pale yellow, clypeus light in colour. Thoracic pleura dark. Pronotum yellow, contrasting strongly with the head and wing scales; anterior margin concave, the sides rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave. Coxae, femora and the upper part of the tibiae dark, the lower part of the tibiae pale yellow. Wing scales extremely dark brown, strongly contrasting with the yellow pronotum. Abdominal tergites and sternites yellow. The row labels of the measurement table of the original are damaged in the scanned text, so the values cannot be matched one by one and are not listed here.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, darker anteriorly than posteriorly; rectangular, the sides straight and parallel; the anterior part densely covered with setae, sparser posteriorly; the frons rather flat, gently inclined. Antenna 14—17 segments; segment 3 distinctly larger than segment 2, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4. Eyes without pigment; a small white spot above the eye, possibly a vestigial ocellus. Mandibles black, the left with several smaller teeth, the teeth of the right distinct. Pronotum yellow, concolorous with the posterior part of the head; anterior margin concave, the sides rounded, the posterior margin arcuate and angulate with the sides. Arolium present. Abdomen yellow. Measurements: total length 8.86—10.99 mm; head length 3.78—4.25 mm; head width 1.80—2.07 mm; pronotum width 1.67—2.15 mm; hind tibia length 1.28—1.35 mm.
